# 2 Kings Chapter 14 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 234v–235v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/2KI_014_page_001.jpg, 2KI_014_page_002.jpg, 2KI_014_page_003.jpg

---

**14:1** In-the-second year of-Yo'ash [Jehoash] son of-Yo'achaz [Jehoahaz], king of-Yisra'el, reigned Amatsyahu [Amaziah] son of-Yo'ash, king of-Yehudah.

**14:2** A-son of-twenty-five years [was he] when-he-became-king, and-twenty-nine years he-reigned in-Yerushalayim. And-the-name of-his-mother [was] Yeho'addin [Jehoaddin] from-Yerushalayim.

**14:3** And-he-did the-right [ha-yashar] in-the-eyes of-YHWH, only not like-David his-father. According-to-all that Yo'ash his-father did, he-did.

**14:4** Only the-high-places [ha-bamot] were-not removed; the-people [were] still sacrificing and-burning-incense on-the-high-places.

**14:5** And-it-was when the-kingdom was-firm [chazqah] in-his-hand, and-he-struck [vayakh] his-servants [avadav], the-ones-striking [ha-makkiym] the-king his-father.

**14:6** And-the-sons of-the-strikers [ha-makkiym] he-did-not put-to-death, according-to-what-is-written in-the-book of-the-Torah of-Mosheh, which YHWH commanded, saying: Fathers shall-not be-put-to-death on-account-of [al] sons, and-sons shall-not be-put-to-death on-account-of fathers; but each in-his-own-sin [be-chet'o] shall-die.

**14:7** He struck Edom in-the-Valley of-Salt [gey ha-melach], ten-thousand, and-seized the-Rock [ha-sela'] in-the-war [ba-milchamah], and-called its-name Yoqte'el [Joktheel] to this-day.

**14:8** Then sent Amatsyah messengers [mal'akhim] to Yeho'ash son of-Yeho'achaz son of-Yehu, king of-Yisra'el, saying: Come, let-us-look-at-faces [nitra'eh fanim] — [let us confront one another].

**14:9** And-sent Yeho'ash king of-Yisra'el to Amatsyah king of-Yehudah, saying: The-thistle [ha-choach] that [is] in-the-Levanon [Lebanon] sent to the-cedar [ha-erez] that [is] in-the-Levanon, saying: Give your-daughter to-my-son for-a-wife [le-ishah]. And-passed a-wild-beast of-the-field [chayyat ha-sadeh] that [is] in-the-Levanon and-trampled [vatirmos] the-thistle.

**14:10** You-have-indeed-struck [hakkeh hikkita] Edom, and-your-heart has-lifted-you [nesa'akha libbkha]. Be-honored [hikkaved] and-sit [in] your-house! And-why should-you-engage [titgareh] in-evil [be-ra'ah] and-fall — you and-Yehudah with-you?

**14:11** And-did-not listen [lo shama'] Amatsyah. And-went-up Yeho'ash king of-Yisra'el, and-they-looked-at-faces [vayitra'u fanim] — he and-Amatsyah king of-Yehudah — at-Beyt-Shemesh [Beth-shemesh], which [belongs] to-Yehudah.

**14:12** And-was-defeated [vayinnagef] Yehudah before Yisra'el, and-they-fled each to-his-tent ['ohalo].

**14:13** And-Amatsyah king of-Yehudah, son of-Yeho'ash son of-Achazyahu, Yeho'ash king of-Yisra'el seized [tafas] at-Beyt-Shemesh. And-they-came [to] Yerushalayim, and-he-broke-through [vayifrotz] the-wall of-Yerushalayim at-the-gate of-Efrayim to the-Corner Gate [sha'ar ha-pinnah], four-hundred cubits ['amah].

**14:14** And-he-took all the-gold and-the-silver and-all the-vessels [ha-kelim] that-were-found [in] the-house of-YHWH and-in-the-treasuries of-the-house of-the-king, and-the-sons of-pledges [beney ha-ta'aruvot] [hostages], and-returned [to] Shomron.

**14:15** And-the-rest of-the-acts of-Yeho'ash that he-did, and-his-might, and-how he-fought with Amatsyah king of-Yehudah, are-they-not written in-the-book of-the-chronicles of-the-kings of-Yisra'el?

**14:16** And-lay-down Yeho'ash with-his-fathers and-was-buried in-Shomron with the-kings of-Yisra'el. And-reigned Yarov'am [Jeroboam] his-son in-his-place.

**14:17** And-lived Amatsyah son of-Yo'ash, king of-Yehudah, after the-death of-Yeho'ash son of-Yeho'achaz, king of-Yisra'el, fifteen years.

**14:18** And-the-rest of-the-acts of-Amatsyah, are-they-not written in-the-book of-the-chronicles of-the-kings of-Yehudah?

**14:19** And-they-bound against-him a-conspiracy [qesher] in-Yerushalayim, and-he-fled to-Lakhish [Lachish]. And-they-sent after-him to-Lakhish and-put-him-to-death there.

**14:20** And-they-carried-him [vayis'uhu] on the-horses, and-he-was-buried in-Yerushalayim with-his-fathers in-the-city of-David.

**14:21** And-took all the-people of-Yehudah Azaryah [Azariah] — and-he [was] a-son of-sixteen years — and-made-him-king in-place of-his-father Amatsyah.

**14:22** He built Eylat [Elath] and-restored-it to-Yehudah, after the-king lay-down [shakhav] with-his-fathers.

**14:23** In-the-fifteenth year of-Amatsyah son of-Yo'ash, king of-Yehudah, reigned Yarov'am son of-Yo'ash, king of-Yisra'el, in-Shomron, [for] forty-one years.

**14:24** And-he-did the-evil in-the-eyes of-YHWH; he-did-not turn from all the-sins of-Yarov'am son of-Nevat, who caused-Yisra'el-to-sin.

**14:25** He restored [heshiv] the-border [gevul] of-Yisra'el from-Levo-Chamat [the entrance of Hamath] to the-Sea of-the-Aravah [yam ha-'aravah], according-to-the-word of-YHWH God of-Yisra'el, which he-spoke by-the-hand of-his-servant Yonah [Jonah] son of-Amittay, the-prophet, who [was] from-Gat-ha-Chefer [Gath-hepher].

**14:26** For YHWH saw the-affliction ['oni] of-Yisra'el, [that it was] very bitter [moreh me'od], and-there-was-none restrained ['atzur] and-none free ['azuv], and-there-was-no helper ['ozer] for-Yisra'el.

**14:27** And-YHWH had-not spoken to-blot-out [limchot] the-name of-Yisra'el from-under the-heavens, and-he-saved-them [vayoshi'em] by-the-hand of-Yarov'am son of-Yo'ash.

**14:28** And-the-rest of-the-acts of-Yarov'am and-all that he-did, and-his-might, how he-fought and-how he-restored Dammeseq [Damascus] and-Chamat [Hamath] to-Yehudah in-Yisra'el, are-they-not written in-the-book of-the-chronicles of-the-kings of-Yisra'el?

**14:29** And-lay-down Yarov'am with-his-fathers, with the-kings of-Yisra'el. And-reigned Zekharyah [Zechariah] his-son in-his-place.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.6 — Torah citation:** This is a direct quotation of Deuteronomy 24:16. Amaziah's restraint in not killing the assassins' sons is explicitly grounded in Torah law. It is one of the few instances in Kings where a king's action is directly justified by Mosaic legislation.

**v.9 — the thistle and the cedar:** Hebrew *ha-choach* (thistle/thornbush) and *ha-erez* (cedar). Jehoash's parable is devastatingly dismissive: Amaziah is a weed claiming kinship with a great tree. The wild beast that tramples the thistle is Jehoash himself — a warning that goes unheeded.

**v.14 — sons of pledges (hostages):** Hebrew *beney ha-ta'aruvot* — literally "sons of the mixings/pledges." These are hostages taken to ensure Judah's compliance after defeat. The practice of exchanging hostages was standard in ancient Near Eastern diplomacy.

**v.25 — Jonah son of Amittai:** The same prophet known from the Book of Jonah. Here he prophesies Israel's territorial restoration under Jeroboam II — a remarkably positive oracle for a sinful king (v.24). YHWH uses even wicked kings to fulfill promises.

**v.28 — Damascus and Hamath to Judah in Israel:** A notoriously difficult phrase. It likely means Jeroboam II recovered territories that had once belonged to Judah (when united under David and Solomon) and restored them to Israel's control.

*— EMET*
